project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, localStorage for data
build_system: bun (available at /root/.local/share/mise/shims/bun). No npm/node available. Use --ignore-scripts for install due to Prisma Node version check.
test_framework: vitest (bun run vitest --run). Pre-existing failures in src/env.test.ts due to zod v4 API change (z.object undefined). Content scanner tests pass.
build_command: /root/.local/share/mise/shims/bun run tsc --noEmit (2 pre-existing Prisma type errors can be ignored)
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit to check types (ignore prisma errors). 2. Run vitest --run to verify tests. 3. Run bun run build may not work without full node but tsc is the primary check.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external npm installs. bun available at /root/.local/share/mise/shims/bun. No node/npm. Prisma client generation not possible. Pre-existing type errors in prisma/seed.ts and src/shared/lib/prisma/client.ts are expected.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (use src/shared/). localStorage for user data. No TODOs or placeholders. Use CSS variables (--foreground, --card-bg, --card-border, --accent-primary, --accent-secondary, --accent-success). NEVER use useSyncExternalStore for one-time localStorage reads - use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer. NEVER call router.push() during render phase.
key_patterns: Questions stored as typed arrays in src/features/question-bank/data/. Sessions stored in localStorage under 'cfa-buddy-sessions' key using QuestionSession type. Session storage utilities in src/features/question-bank/utils/session-storage.ts. Dashboard reads sessions via useLocalStorageSessions hook. Review page at /questions/review/[sessionId]. Circular progress ring pattern exists in dashboard-content.tsx (ReadinessGauge) and session-review.tsx (ScoreRing). Topic breakdown with progress bars in session-review.tsx (TopicBar). recharts used for charts. lucide-react for icons. framer-motion available.
directory_structure: src/features/{feature-name}/ with subdirs: actions, components, data, hooks, queries, types, utils, __tests__. src/shared/ for cross-feature code (components/ui, hooks, lib, types). src/app/(protected)/ for authenticated routes.
